title: In-Context Estimation and Prediction for Parametric ODEs
abstract: arXiv:2611.21268v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Transformers have demonstrated the ability to perform in-context learning, that is, to adapt to new tasks from a few examples without updating their parameters. Existing theory has largely focused on emulating gradient-based algorithms for convex statistical problems or establishing general function approximation guarantees without exploiting the underlying statistical structure. We study in-context parameter estimation and trajectory prediction for parametric ordinary differential equations (ODEs), where estimation is generally nonconvex. Under suitable identifiability and regularity conditions, we construct a transformer that estimates unknown system parameters from noisy trajectory observations through a two-stage approximate maximum likelihood procedure: a coarse search provides an initialization within a locally strongly convex region, followed by gradient descent with local linear contraction. translated_title: 参数化常微分方程的上下文估计与预测
translated_abstract: Transformer已经展示了执行上下文学习的能力，即无需更新自身参数，仅凭少量示例就能适应新任务。现有理论主要集中于模拟基于梯度的算法来解决凸统计问题，或建立一般性的函数逼近保证，而未能利用问题背后的统计结构。我们研究参数化常微分方程（ODE）的上下文参数估计与轨迹预测问题，其中参数估计通常是非凸的。在适当的可辨识性和正则性条件下，我们构建了一个Transformer，通过两阶段近似最大似然过程从含噪轨迹观测中估计未知系统参数：首先由粗搜索提供处于局部强凸区域内的初始化，随后执行具有局部线性收缩性的梯度下降。对于预测任务，我们将该估计器组合到后续过程中（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文证明Transformer可以通过“粗搜索初始化+局部强凸区域梯度下降”的两阶段近似最大似然程序，从含噪轨迹观测中对一般非凸的参数化常微分方程实现上下文参数估计与轨迹预测。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that transformers can perform in-context parameter estimation and trajectory prediction for parametric ODEs—a generally nonconvex problem—via a two-stage approximate maximum likelihood procedure combining coarse-search initialization with gradient descent in a locally strongly convex region.
